_comment: Where wow.py reads the chat box, for counting 'You receive loot: [...]' lines. region = [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the WoW window: the default is WoW's default chat frame at 1920x1080 (x 32-438, y 760-938 px), stopping short of the player portrait that overlaps its right end, and a couple of pixels below the last line (a line cut off by the edge is never read). line_pitch = pixels from one line of chat text to the next at source_height (18 with the default chat font). If you moved the chat box or changed its font size, use wow_gui.py's Setup tab ('Set chat area'), which saves YOUR box to recordings/wow/chat.json - that file wins over this one. loot_low/high = the HSV colour (OpenCV's 0-180 hue) of the green 'You receive loot:' words: a line is only read when it has at least loot_min_pixels of it (at 18 px pitch; measured 335-379 on loot lines, 0 on every other line). See docs/wow_fishing.md.
